description:
Encryption report for devices in this account

TIP: Per-device encryption report (Intune > Devices > Monitor > Encryption report) — the first stop to diagnose BitLocker or FileVault. Each row has id (the Intune managed device ID), deviceName, userPrincipalName, deviceType, osVersion, tpmSpecificationVersion, encryptionReadinessState (notReady, ready), encryptionState (notEncrypted, encrypted), fileVaultStates, advancedBitLockerStates (bitmask of reasons BitLocker is not enforced: osVolumeEncryptionMethodMismatch, osVolumeTpmRequired, osVolumeTpmOnlyRequired, recoveryKeyBackupFailed, ...) and policyDetails [{policyId, policyName}] — the encryption policies that reached the device. Filter with $filter=encryptionState eq 'notEncrypted', or $filter=deviceName eq 'PC-001' for one device. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $orderby, $count.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.
